confidence_diagnostic.scope: Development-only confidence diagnostics, not a calibrated rejection policy or paired speech accuracy test.
confidence_diagnostic.conclusion: Current noSpeech cannot separate noise from speech; token-confidence-only rejection overlaps dev segments. Reject noSpeech threshold work on this engine.

engine_cause.detail: Prompt preparation selects only the final token logits. Decoder preserves/resizes a multi-token vector and populates only that final offset. no_speech softmax instead reads the first block. A fresh context therefore uses zero-initialized logits (approximately 1/51865); later calls may read stale earlier token logits. Observed fixed near-uniform noSpeech is not calibrated acoustic evidence.

confidence_diagnostic.research_status: An independently reviewed SOT-logit correction exists only in an isolated research snapshot; paired measurements and promotion decisions remain pending. Production engine and submodule are unchanged.
confidence_diagnostic.runtime_caveats: Existing VAD API resets recurrent state on each detect call and provides no per-call abort callback. A future bounded <=30s worker-only pass must honor cancellation around inference, avoid the capture thread, and measure extra model/memory/latency on phone. No production changes or third-party edits were made.

conditioned_vad_control_screen.scope: Separate VAD-only development screen; no ASR or real-room-noise inference.
conditioned_vad_control_screen.conditioner: Per 512-sample frame: env=max(frame RMS, prevEnv*exp(-frameDuration/0.5s)); gain=clip(target/env,1,cap). Starts env=0. RMS includes DC. Ties-to-even PCM16 rounding; no output clipping permitted.
